register_mcss_directives: register all m.css reStructuredText directives and roles with docutils for use in Sphinx documentation
create_transition_directive: create a custom reStructuredText transition directive with the m-transition CSS class for section breaks
create_note_directive: create a styled note box directive with optional title and content for documentation warnings or tips
create_block_directive: create a styled content block directive with a required title and nested content for documentation sections
create_button_directive: create a styled clickable button directive with caption, optional description, and target URL for documentation
